description: Headroom plugin hooks — ensure the local Headroom runtime is available for initialized agents.

hooks.command: sh -c '[ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && launcher="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/headroom-hook.sh" && [ -r "$launcher" ] && exec sh "$launcher"; exec headroom init hook ensure'
